name: nightshade-inline
description: Run Nightshade static analysis and show Compact findings as inline VS Code diagnostics.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Nightshade downloads an analyzer and runs Docker; trust the workspace to enable scanning.

nightshade.autoInstall.description: Install the latest stable GitHub release when the default Nightshade Docker image is missing. Requires a running Docker daemon.

nightshade.dockerPath.description: Path or command used to start Docker.

nightshade.dockerImage.description: Docker image to use. The default reuses a managed release or local nightshade image, and installs the latest stable release if missing. Custom images must be installed manually.

nightshade.compilerVersion.description: Nightshade analysis profile. Match the Compact compiler used by the project.

nightshade.maxPaths.description: Maximum abstract execution paths Nightshade may analyze per rule.

nightshade.maxSteps.description: Maximum abstract execution steps Nightshade may analyze per rule.

nightshade.runOnSave.description: Scan a Compact file after it is saved.

nightshade.scanWorkspaceOnOpen.description: Automatically scan an opened workspace folder when it contains Compact files.

nightshade.scanOnOpen.description: Automatically scan a Compact file when it is opened.

scripts.package: npm run compile && vsce package --out nightshade-inline.vsix
